svg.title: Pundoku mark — D2 «Девять»
svg.desc: Geometric nine. Bowl is a circle r=230 at (512,420); the counter is a rounded square (190, r=56) instead of a circle — so the same shape reads both as the digit 9 and as one cell of the grid. The tail is the bowl's own right wall (135 wide, the same weight everywhere) continued down to y=830 and cut flat. Non-zero fill rule: bowl and tail wind clockwise, the counter counter-clockwise.
